gloss_en: chalal (חָלָל) — a void/empty space that is simultaneously the slain corpse of Deuteronomy 21:1 ("when a chalal is found in the land"), signifying the withdrawal (histalkut) of holiness/vitality; linked by wordplay to chilul (desecration) of Shabbat — not a flute (chalil), nor the profaned priest (chalal) in its halakhic sense
